mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Sometimes, the deepest scars aren't the ones we can see. They linger in quiet moments, shaping everyday life long after any battle has ended. Together, we're about to step into a remarkable story—one told in Until Tuesday: A Wounded Warrior and the Golden Retriever Who Saved Him, written by Luis Carlos Montalván. This isn't just a tale about a decorated veteran and his loyal service dog. It's an invitation to explore how hope, resilience, and healing can blossom even when life feels overwhelming. As we follow this journey, you'll meet Tuesday, a golden retriever whose gentle presence becomes so much more than comfort—he's a lifeline, a source of stability, and a reason to keep moving forward. Through moments of struggle and triumph, we'll see how trust is rebuilt, and how the smallest victories can shine a light in the darkest places. So, let’s walk this path together. Along the way, you might just find yourself reflecting on the healing power of connection, and how sometimes, hope comes from the most unexpected companions.
